# Toriut

> Toriut is a multi-channel Product Information Management (PIM) platform built by TopTechPhoto. Centralize product data, media, and variants across all your sales channels from one master catalog.

## Product

- [Toriut PIM](https://toriut.com/): Multi-channel PIM for managing products, variants, metafields, and media across sales channels. Bulk editing, multi-store sync, AI enrichment, real-time channel integration.
- [Pricing](https://toriut.com/pricing): Current plans and trial options for Toriut PIM.
- [Book a Demo](https://toriut.com/book-a-demo): Schedule a live 1:1 demo with a Toriut product expert.

## Features

- [Advanced Filter Panel](https://toriut.com/advanced-filter-panel): Multi-criteria filtering across large catalogs - by attributes, variants, tags, and custom fields.
- [Product Variants Management](https://toriut.com/shopify-product-variants-management): Manage complex product variants - color, size, material - across multiple sales channels at scale.
- [Product Image Management](https://toriut.com/shopify-product-image-management): Centralize your media library. Find, match, and sync product images across channels.
- [Bulk Media Match](https://toriut.com/bulk-media-match-for-shopify): Automatically match and upload images and videos to products in bulk.
- [DAM - Digital Asset Management](https://toriut.com/dam-for-shopify): Digital asset management integrated with your product catalog. Organize, tag, and sync media files.

## Tools

- [AI Product Description Generator](https://toriut.com/product-description-generator): Free AI tool that generates product titles, descriptions, and keywords from a product image. Works with any e-commerce platform. No sign-up required.

## Solutions by Industry

- [PIM for Fashion](https://toriut.com/pim-for-fashion): PIM for fashion and apparel brands. Manage size, color, and material variants at scale.
- [PIM for Cosmetics](https://toriut.com/pim-for-cosmetics): PIM for beauty and cosmetics brands. Consistent product data across all sales channels.
- [PIM for Retail](https://toriut.com/pim-for-retail): PIM for retail businesses. Manage large product catalogs and multi-channel operations.
- [PIM for Small Business](https://toriut.com/pim-for-small-business): PIM for growing businesses. Streamline product data without enterprise-level complexity.
- [PIM for Shopify](https://toriut.com/pim-for-shopify): PIM built for Shopify merchants. Manage product data, variants, and media across single and multi-store setups.
- [DAM for Shopify](https://toriut.com/dam-for-shopify): Digital asset management for Shopify. Bulk upload, match, and sync product media.
